audit_items.rationale: This check targets P2P gossip validation of commitment_indices bounds before verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl. The Nethermind codebase wraps the c-kzg library via Ckzg.VerifyCellKzgProofBatch(). The internal validation logic (verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl) is implemented in the external c-kzg dependency, not in the Nethermind wrapper code. The wrapper code in BlobProofsManagerV1.ValidateProofs() does not expose commitment_indices directly - it generates them internally as sequential indices (0 to CellsPerExtBlob-1).

This check tests whether a malicious P2P peer can crash a validator node via crafted commitment_indices. In Nethermind, the commitment_indices are generated internally in BlobProofsManagerV1.ValidateProofs() as sequential values (indices[cellNumber] = (ulong)j). These are not directly controllable via P2P input. The bounds checking is delegated to the external c-kzg library.

This check assesses memory safety impact of out-of-bounds commitment_indices access. The Nethermind codebase is written in C# (memory-safe language). The underlying c-kzg library is written in C, but memory safety validation would need to be performed on the external dependency. Nethermind's wrapper generates indices safely as sequential values within bounds.

This check verifies that all four input arrays have equal length in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch. In Nethermind's BlobProofsManagerV1.ValidateProofs(), the arrays are allocated with consistent sizes based on wrapper.Blobs.Length * Ckzg.CellsPerExtBlob. The ValidateLengths() method explicitly checks: wrapper.Blobs.Length == wrapper.Commitments.Length && wrapper.Blobs.Length * Ckzg.CellsPerExtBlob == wrapper.Proofs.Length. Length validation occurs BEFORE ValidateProofs() is called in MempoolBlobTxValidator.ValidateBlobs().
audit_items.evidence: Line 51: if (wrapper.Blobs.Length != wrapper.Commitments.Length || wrapper.Blobs.Length * Ckzg.CellsPerExtBlob != wrapper.Proofs.Length) { return false; }. Further per-element length checks at lines 56-67.

audit_items.rationale: This check verifies P2P gossip validation enforces equal-length constraint. In Nethermind, the validation chain is: MempoolBlobTxValidator.ValidateBlobs() -> proofsManager.ValidateLengths(wrapper) before proofsManager.ValidateProofs(wrapper). This provides defense-in-depth at the application layer before KZG verification.

This check tests if mismatched array lengths could crash a validator node. Nethermind's ValidateLengths() rejects mismatched lengths before cryptographic processing. Additionally, ValidateProofs() wraps the Ckzg call in try-catch for ArgumentException, ApplicationException, and InsufficientMemoryException, returning false instead of crashing.
audit_items.evidence: Lines 103-106: catch (Exception e) when (e is ArgumentException or ApplicationException or InsufficientMemoryException) { return false; }

audit_items.rationale: This check verifies array length validation occurs BEFORE cryptographic operations. In Nethermind, MempoolBlobTxValidator.ValidateBlobs() calls ValidateLengths() FIRST, returning error immediately if it fails, before calling ValidateProofs().

This check validates cell_index bounds against CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB. In Nethermind, cell indices are generated internally as sequential values 0 to CellsPerExtBlob-1 (line 95: indices[cellNumber] = (ulong)j where j < Ckzg.CellsPerExtBlob). External P2P input cannot inject arbitrary cell_index values. The bounds validation in coset_for_cell is in the external c-kzg library.

This check validates P2P gossip rejection of cell_index >= CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB. In Nethermind's architecture, cell_indices are not directly received from P2P - they are computed internally during proof verification. The DataColumnSidecar concept referenced in the check is not present in this execution client codebase (it's a consensus layer concept).

This check tests P2P peer crash via out-of-bounds cell_index. In Nethermind, the cell_indices are generated internally as bounded values (j from 0 to CellsPerExtBlob-1). The crash scenario from out-of-bounds cell_index in coset functions applies to the external c-kzg library implementation.

This check verifies cell_index bounds validation before coset functions. The coset_for_cell and coset_shift_for_cell functions are internal to the c-kzg library. Nethermind's wrapper code generates bounded indices and does not expose these internal functions.

This check tests integer overflow in FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index. This computation occurs within the c-kzg library, not in Nethermind's wrapper code. The overflow analysis applies to the external dependency.

This check validates commitment_bytes, cell, and proof_bytes lengths. Nethermind's BlobProofsManagerV1.ValidateLengths() explicitly validates: wrapper.Blobs[i].Length == Ckzg.BytesPerBlob, wrapper.Commitments[i].Length == Ckzg.BytesPerCommitment, and wrapper.Proofs[i].Length == Ckzg.BytesPerProof.
audit_items.evidence: Lines 55-67: for loops checking wrapper.Blobs[i].Length != Ckzg.BytesPerBlob || wrapper.Commitments[i].Length != Ckzg.BytesPerCommitment and wrapper.Proofs[i].Length != Ckzg.BytesPerProof

audit_items.rationale: This check tests crash/corruption from incorrect commitment_bytes length. Nethermind's ValidateLengths() validates wrapper.Commitments[i].Length != Ckzg.BytesPerCommitment returns false before any cryptographic operations. This prevents malformed data from reaching the c-kzg library.
audit_items.evidence: Lines 55-59: if (wrapper.Blobs[i].Length != Ckzg.BytesPerBlob || wrapper.Commitments[i].Length != Ckzg.BytesPerCommitment) { return false; }

audit_items.rationale: This check tests crash/corruption from incorrect cell length. Nethermind validates wrapper.Blobs[i].Length != Ckzg.BytesPerBlob. Cells are computed internally from validated blobs via Ckzg.ComputeCells(), not received directly from P2P in potentially malformed form.
audit_items.evidence: Blob length validated at line 56. Cells computed internally at line 88: Ckzg.ComputeCells(cells.Slice(...), wrapper.Blobs[i], ...)

audit_items.rationale: This check tests crash/corruption from incorrect proof_bytes length. Nethermind's ValidateLengths() validates wrapper.Proofs[i].Length != Ckzg.BytesPerProof returns false before cryptographic operations.
audit_items.evidence: Lines 62-67: for (int i = 0; i < wrapper.Proofs.Length; i++) { if (wrapper.Proofs[i].Length != Ckzg.BytesPerProof) { return false; } }

audit_items.rationale: This check verifies array length consistency validation. Nethermind's ValidateLengths() validates: len(blobs) == len(commitments) && len(blobs) * CellsPerExtBlob == len(proofs), plus per-element byte length validation.
audit_items.evidence: Line 51: if (wrapper.Blobs.Length != wrapper.Commitments.Length || wrapper.Blobs.Length * Ckzg.CellsPerExtBlob != wrapper.Proofs.Length)

audit_items.rationale: This check verifies P2P gossip validation layer enforces byte length constraints. In Nethermind, MempoolBlobTxValidator is registered as a validator for TxType.Blob transactions. It calls ValidateLengths() before ValidateProofs(), providing defense-in-depth at the application layer.
audit_items.evidence: MempoolBlobTxValidator.Instance registered at line 60. ValidateLengths called first at line 287.

audit_items.rationale: This check verifies bytes_to_kzg_commitment performs BLS12-381 G1 subgroup check. This function is internal to the c-kzg library. Nethermind calls Ckzg.VerifyCellKzgProofBatch() which handles deserialization internally.

This check verifies bytes_to_kzg_proof performs BLS12-381 G1 subgroup check. This function is internal to the c-kzg library. Nethermind delegates proof deserialization and validation to the external library.
This check analyzes pairing check impact with non-subgroup points. The pairing equation implementation is in the c-kzg library. Nethermind's wrapper does not implement pairing operations directly.

This check tests subgroup check bypass via DataColumnSidecar. DataColumnSidecar is a consensus layer concept. Nethermind is an execution client that receives blob data via transaction wrapper, not directly via DataColumnSidecar P2P messages.
This check verifies verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch assumptions about subgroup validation. The function implementation and its assumptions are in the c-kzg library, not in Nethermind's wrapper.

This check validates the cryptographic library's subgroup check implementation. The c-kzg library is the dependency. Nethermind uses the C# binding (CkzgLib) without implementing subgroup checks directly.

This check verifies commitment deduplication preserves semantic equivalence. The deduplication logic and commitment_indices mapping in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch are internal to the c-kzg library implementation.
This check verifies commitment_indices mapping is bijective. This is an internal implementation detail of the c-kzg library's batch verification algorithm.
This check tests proof forgery exploitation via commitment deduplication. The deduplication algorithm is in the c-kzg library. Nethermind's wrapper does not manipulate the deduplication logic.
This check assesses validator-node impact if commitment deduplication fails. The deduplication correctness is a property of the c-kzg library. Nethermind trusts the library's return value.

This check verifies recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs rejects <50% cells. The recovery function is not present in Nethermind's execution client codebase. Cell recovery is a consensus layer operation typically done by beacon nodes.
This check verifies 50% threshold derivation from CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB. The recovery function and threshold checking are not implemented in Nethermind's execution client.
This check tests P2P peer cell withholding attack. Cell recovery and reconstruction is a consensus layer operation. Nethermind as an execution client does not implement cell recovery from P2P.
This check assesses blast radius if recovery proceeds with insufficient cells. Recovery operations are not present in the Nethermind execution client codebase.
This check verifies cell count pre-condition ordering in recovery. The recovery function is not implemented in Nethermind's execution client.
This check validates cell_indices uniqueness and ascending order before recovery. The recovery function is not implemented in Nethermind's execution client - this is a consensus layer operation.
This check verifies polynomial interpolation assumptions about unique/sorted cell_indices. Polynomial interpolation for recovery is implemented in the c-kzg library, not in Nethermind.
This check tests P2P injection of duplicate cell_indices. Nethermind's execution client does not receive cell_indices directly from P2P for recovery operations.
This check validates cell_indices range [0, CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB) before recovery. Recovery operations are consensus layer functionality not present in Nethermind execution client.
This check tests coset_for_cell crash with out-of-range cell_index. The coset_for_cell function is internal to the c-kzg library, not exposed or reimplemented in Nethermind.
This check tests P2P injection of out-of-range cell_indices to crash node. Recovery operations with cell_indices from P2P are not implemented in Nethermind execution client.
This check verifies cell_index range validation ordering before resource allocation. Recovery function implementation is not present in Nethermind execution client.

This check verifies post-recovery KZG commitment verification for all recovered cells. Recovery and post-recovery verification are consensus layer operations not implemented in Nethermind execution client.
This check verifies all callers of recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs verify recovered data. The recovery function is not present in Nethermind execution client - this is beacon node functionality.
This check tests malicious P2P peer causing validator to distribute corrupted recovered cells. Cell recovery and distribution is consensus layer functionality not in Nethermind execution client.

This check tests if validator trusts reconstructed data without verification. Reconstruction/recovery is a consensus layer operation. Nethermind execution client validates blob proofs but doesn't perform cell recovery.
This check verifies original_commitment source integrity for verification. Recovery operations that require commitment verification are not present in Nethermind execution client.

This check validates recovered polynomial degree before truncation in recover_polynomialcoeff. The polynomial recovery function is in the c-kzg library and not directly used by Nethermind execution client.
This check tests validator detection/rejection of incorrect polynomials from recovery. Recovery operations are consensus layer functionality not present in Nethermind execution client.
This check tests P2P peer crafting cell data to force polynomial degree >= FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB. Recovery operations are not implemented in Nethermind execution client.
This check verifies division by zero prevention in recover_polynomialcoeff. The polynomial recovery implementation is in the c-kzg library, not in Nethermind.
This check validates PRIMITIVE_ROOT_OF_UNITY correctness. This cryptographic constant and its usage in coset operations is internal to the c-kzg library implementation.
